findings.description: Shoulder no longer floats, but short bell/cone base changes abruptly into narrow straight arm. Broad end reads as an applied cuff rather than a muscular emergence. No open root slot or detached shoulder seen, so this is eligible form correction rather than hard veto.

Dorsal fins read as repeated rounded pebble/petal lobes; cheek masses read as ear discs. They supply volume but miss the target's swept, tapered aquatic fin identity. This is macro silhouette, not scales/finish.

Much better continuous neck has mild ring-like curvature/shading transition at torso end in profiles/underside. Smooth longitudinal radius derivative while preserving new shared surface; do not reintroduce overlapping collars.

boundedCorrection.hypothesis: Abrupt, short longitudinal profile changes produce both the shoulder cuff and rounded fin masses. A single controlled profile/tangent revision—longer torso-tangent shoulder taper and asymmetric swept fin profiles—will remove cuff/bead readings while retaining the now-correct continuous skin and closed volumes.
controls: Same target, all 18 cameras/timestamps, global scale, API and gate thresholds.
Keep shared continuous nose-to-tail construction and closed cambered fluke; no new collars or flat-plane shortcuts.
Shoulder broad base follows local torso tangent across a longer footprint; taper smoothly into humerus with no cap ridge, disk, or short cone.
Dorsal/cheek fins use swept asymmetric leading/trailing contours, broad buried root and tapered tips. Retain finite thickness and avoid needle spikes; preserve ordered size falloff.
Preserve wing three-finger membranes and articulated fold. Do not increase detail to disguise root geometry.
Repeat all 18 original frames plus root close-ups only if needed to disambiguate contact.
passConditions: Shoulder integration improves .75 to at least .85; dorsal/cheek fin identity .76 to at least .86.
No critical regression greater than .05; no new hard veto.
Same dominant defect, insufficient gain, or post-correction score below .75 retires family2; no automatic further family.
